rows.label: Municipal income tax: range 16% to 21.50%
rows.value: Municipal income tax is a flat rate set by each municipality (16% to 21.50% in 2026, mostly 19% to 21%) on income above the DKK 30,000 basic deduction.

source.title: Hvussu roknar man skatt? (how income tax is calculated: municipal, national and church tax)

rows.label: Church tax: maximum 0.95% (0.65% national + 0.30% local)
rows.note: national church tax (at most 0.65%) plus local church tax (at most 0.30%), members of the national church only. Unit: share of taxable income (maximum).

source.title: Hvussu roknar man skatt? (how income tax is calculated: municipal, national and church tax)

rows.label: Income tax is the sum of municipal, national and church tax, each on its own base
rows.value: Municipal tax is proportional on income above the DKK 30,000 basic deduction; national tax is progressive from DKK 65,000; church tax for members of the Church of the Faroes
